Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Performance marketing at Kraken is being rebuilt from the ground up. Manual bid management, creative iteration, budget allocation, and audience targeting are being replaced by agent systems that detect signals, make decisions, and execute continuously, learning from every result.

As Sr. Performance Marketing Manager, Growth Systems, you bring deep paid growth expertise and apply it to the systems replacing manual execution. Your job is to define the logic: what signals matter, what decisions should be automated, what guardrails must exist, and what the creative feedback loop looks like across paid channels. The engineers build what you spec. The agents run what you design.

While your primary focus is performance and paid growth, you will also contribute to automating other growth levers, including CRO, incentives, referrals, and cross-channel workflows, as the engine expands. The domain expertise is your anchor. The systems thinking is what scales it.

This role is for someone who has run growth at scale and found themselves constantly asking why are we doing this manually. If you've felt the ceiling of what human-operated paid growth can achieve and want to build the system that breaks through it, this is that role.

The opportunity

  • Refine creative and copy variants generated by the AI creative layer, applying domain judgment to what will perform before the data confirms it

  • QA agent outputs, review what the system produces, identify where it falls short, and define the corrections that improve it

  • Monitor workflow performance and continuously improve, this system compounds with your input, it does not run itself

  • Define and spec automation workflows for paid growth, from creative fatigue detection to budget reallocation to geo level channel mix optimization to audience signal processing

  • Work directly with the build team to translate your workflow specs into working agent automations

  • Define knowledge base inputs for the paid growth agents, what rules, guardrails, and campaign logic should be codified and kept current

  • Extend your systems thinking to other growth levers, CRO, incentives, referrals, and lifecycle, as the engine expands across growth functions

What you bring

  • 8+ years in performance or paid growth, you have run campaigns at scale across major paid channels and understand the mechanics deeply

  • Deep expertise across core paid channels (Meta, Google/YouTube, TikTok, Apple Search Ads, programmatic/DSPs) rather than just "major paid channels" generically

  • Comfort with data, you can read a performance dashboard, interpret signal from noise, and define what an agent should optimize for

  • Strong written communication, the workflow specs you write become the blueprints engineers build from. Clarity matters.

  • Systems thinking, you can map a growth workflow as a series of triggers, decisions, actions, and measurements. You think in logic, not just tactics

  • Prompt engineering curiosity, you don't need to be an engineer, but you are willing to learn how to communicate with AI systems precisely and improve their outputs

  • High agency, you define the work, you don't wait for it to be defined for you

Nice to haves

  • Experience with marketing automation, CRM, or lifecycle messaging systems

  • Exposure to A/B testing and experimentation frameworks

  • Background in fintech, consumer financial products, or regulated industries

  • Any hands-on experience with workflow automation or no-code orchestration tools

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

The Starknet Foundation is the steward of Starknet, a permissionless validity rollup designed to scale the world’s most important blockchains without compromise. Joining the Starknet Foundation now places you at the epicenter of this pivotal phase and offers a rare, ground-floor opportunity to shape how Starknet's core growth verticals evolve: from BTCFi and privacy to quantum resistance and real-world assets. This is a unique chance to build the infrastructure that turns the world's most secure assets and most sensitive use cases into productive, scalable capital for a billion users, and it requires exceptional talent. We're looking for people who think in systems, operate well in ambiguity, and are motivated by long-term impact over short-term wins. If you want your work to outlast a market cycle and define how decentralized systems actually scale, this is the place to do it.

If you've negotiated complex commercial terms from term sheet to close and want to apply that skill set to the highest-leverage infrastructure decisions in crypto, this role is built for you.

 

What You’ll Bring

  • Senior generalist with a proven ability to operate cross-functionally across strategy, BD, partnerships, and product development.

  • Demonstrated ability to build complex financial models, structure incentive/economic terms (e.g., token incentive design, revenue share, earn-outs, vesting/cliff structures), and negotiate multi-party commercial agreements from term sheet to close.

  • Crypto and DeFi native with minimum 5+ years of experience.

  • Ideal background in banking, management consulting or legal training, with experience at a Tier one company within the industry.

  • Strong commercial and research skills, including the ability to build clear business cases and financial models.

  • A deep crypto network and a track record of building senior relationships with DeFi protocols, LPs and financial institutions that generated revenue/growth.

What You Need To Succeed

  • Self-starter with high energy, motivation, and ambition.

  • Comfortable defining success for a specific vertical, identifying gaps and reallocating efforts toward the highest-value opportunities.

  • Proven ability to influence senior executives and work effectively with stakeholders across the organisation.

  • Strong deal experience and negotiation skills

What You’ll Do

  • Take ownership of strategy and execution across the Growth team's priority verticals (Privacy, Bitcoin, Quantum, RWA), with the flexibility to shift focus as new opportunities and priorities emerge.

  • Identify, negotiate and manage partnerships end-to-end to extend and strengthen Starknet’s infrastructure stack.

  • Develop commercial proposals that drive growth across the Starknet ecosystem.

  • Work with product, ecosystem and marketing teams to identify and build new solutions that drive partner ecosystem success.

  • Partner with legal, finance, and operations teams to support existing and upcoming partnerships.

  • Represent Starknet at conferences and industry events to enhance visibility and connection to top-tier projects.

Location:

We are a globally dispersed, remote-first organization. However, for this role we are partial to candidates based and with networks in: APAC (Singapore/HK) and NYC.

Who We Are

The Solana Foundation is a non-profit based in Zug, Switzerland, dedicated to the adoption, decentralization, and security of the Solana network. Solana is a high performance blockchain that can deliver a fast and friendly user experience, without sacrificing security. The Solana Foundation is working to realize a world where individuals own their data, use permissionless networks, and transfer information and value freely around the world. We are looking for talented people who are willing to jump right in and use their expertise to help the ecosystem build.

What We Do

The Foundation collaborates with both internal contributors and external ecosystem teams to solve key technical challenges and accelerate the development of core infrastructure, developer tooling, and open source standards. This includes everything from on-chain protocols to growth tooling, smart contract frameworks, and new developer experiences.

We work closely with many of the most ambitious teams in crypto — including those building next-generation DeFi, payments, gaming, DePIN, and Real-World Asset platforms.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for talented Solana Program Engineers, with a strong emphasis on developers who have built — or want to build — cutting-edge DeFi protocols on Solana.

This is an open application to express your interest in working on one of several high-impact teams across the Solana ecosystem. Depending on your background and interests, we may connect you with projects building:

Advanced DeFi Protocols

  • Central Limit Order Books (CLOBs)

  • On-chain AMMs and hybrid liquidity models

  • Lending markets, margin trading, and perps

  • Bonding curves and structured products

  • Oracle integrations and liquidation engines

  • Governance, fee sharing, and staking mechanisms

Core Infrastructure & Tooling

  • Smart contract wallets and programmable access

  • Gasless relayers and session keys

  • Indexers and custom RPCs

  • Anchor / Pinocchio contributions

On-chain Applications & Middleware

  • Token launch frameworks and fair distribution tooling

  • Real-world asset registries and payment rails

  • DePIN coordination systems

Selected candidates will be matched with ecosystem teams (and in some cases, the Foundation’s internal contributors) based on your skills, interests, and availability. Roles vary from full-time to grant-based, depending on the team.

You’ll Be Great at This If You…

  • Build high-performance production grade Solana programs in Rust (Anchor or Native)

  • Are passionate about DeFi and familiar with onchain mechanics

  • Love taking ideas from 0→1 and iterating quickly with real users

  • Can reason about technical trade-offs and system design under constraints

  • Enjoy contributing to open source and improving developer tools

  • Thrive in startup-like environments: fast-paced, independent, and impact-driven

  • Looking for entrepreneurial, founding opportunities with the smartest people and skin in the game early on.

Desired Background

  • 2+ years of experience building and shipping Solana programs

  • Strong familiarity with Solana’s runtime (SVM), SPL tokens, PDAs, and Anchor

  • Hands-on experience building or contributing to DeFi protocols

  • Understanding of state compression, account metering, and program optimization

  • Bonus: Familiarity with Solana-native DeFi protocols like OpenBook, Jupiter, MarginFi, Orca, or Meteora

Ready to build the next generation of DeFi?

If you’re a Rust engineer excited to work on the bleeding edge of Solana — whether you’ve already deployed programs or are looking to level up — we want to hear from you.

Submit your info and we’ll reach out as opportunities arise across the Solana ecosystem.

Espresso AI’s mission is to use machine learning to automate performance engineering. Today, we help our customers reduce Snowflake and Databricks SQL compute costs by up to 70%, unlocking massive efficiency gains without requiring any workflow changes.


More and more businesses are adopting data warehouses to manage invaluable data analytics workloads. Our next-generation, AI-based approach saves our users huge amounts of money.
